This page collects seminar notes, reading reports prepared for courses, and
independent expositions (which were mostly written in my freshman and sophomore years, focusing on some simple algebraic facts or problems). 

Some of these writing were originally in Chinese if there is Chinese version available. The English version for these notes were translated and organized by Chatgpt and I haven't had time to check them.

<section class="work-entry">

<div class="work-head">
<h3 class="work-title">Holomorphic Anomaly Equation in Two Polarizations</h3>

<div class="work-head-links">
<a class="text-link" href="files/expositions/seminar-notes/Verlinde_paper_two_polarizations.pdf">English PDF</a>
</div>
</div>

<details class="work-info">
<summary>Info</summary>

<div class="work-info-body">
<p>This is the notes for my talk in *Mirror Symmetry Seminar*, organized by Prof. Emanuel Scheidegger in 2026 spring semester. The topic for that semester is to discuss about the paper *Quantum Background Independence in String Theory* by E. Witten and other consequencet results under his understanding of HAE through the viewpoint of background independence. 

I talked about sections 5.1 and 5.2 in the paper *Attractors and The Holomorphic Anomaly* by E. Verlinde, carrying out concrete calculations of HAE in holomorphic and real polarizations and correcting some error signs in Verlinde's original paper.</p>
</div>

</details>

</section>



<section class="work-entry">

<div class="work-head">
<h3 class="work-title">Speical Kähler Geometry</h3>

<div class="work-head-links">
<a class="text-link" href="files/expositions/seminar-notes/Special_Geometry.pdf">English PDF</a>
</div>
</div>

<details class="work-info">
<summary>Info</summary>

<div class="work-info-body">
<p>This is the notes for my talk in *Mirror Symmetry Seminar*, organized by Prof. Emanuel Scheidegger in 2025 fall semester. The topic for that semester is to discuss about the paper *BCOV Ring and Holomorphic Anomaly Equation* by S. Hosono. 

I talked about sections 2-5 and 2-6, adding more mathematical background on special Kähler Geometry which are not discussed in detail in Hosono's paper.</p>
</div>

</details>

</section>



<section class="work-entry">

<div class="work-head">
<h3 class="work-title">Construction of Hyperbolic Surfaces and Dense Geodesics</h3>

<div class="work-head-links">

</div>

<details class="work-info">
<summary>Info</summary>

<div class="work-info-body">
<p>This is the notes for my talk in *Undergraduate Geometry Seminar* organized by Xiang Ma in 2024 spring semester, in which we read the book *Geometry of Surfaces* by J.Stillwell. 

I talked about section 5.4-5.5 in the seminar, which are about dense geodesics on punctured sphere and construction of hyperbolic surfaces by polygon gluing.</p>
</div>

</details>

</section>
